userStories.notes: Files: .gitignore (only). Edit region: lines 43-60 of the current .gitignore (the .cam-* runtime markers block that starts with the existing '.claude/.cam-orch-session' entry); add a '# CAM-68: escaped harness runtime markers (orchestrator + setup + handoff + sidecar)' grouping comment and the 7 entries directly underneath, matching the existing one-line-per-rule style. Order suggestion: orchestrator-prompt, setup-menu, setup-prompt, orch-ready, sidecar.pid, orch-handoff.json, orch-handoff.consumed.json. After editing, run `git rm --cached .claude/.cam-orchestrator-prompt.txt .claude/.cam-setup-menu.sh .claude/.cam-setup-prompt.txt` (working copies stay; these files are rewritten every cam run / cam setup so the operator keeps them locally). Do NOT use --no-verify on the commit. Sanity-check before commit: `for f in .claude/.cam-orchestrator-prompt.txt .claude/.cam-setup-menu.sh .claude/.cam-setup-prompt.txt .claude/.cam-orch-ready .claude/.cam-sidecar.pid .claude/.cam-orch-handoff.json .claude/.cam-orch-handoff.consumed.json; do git check-ignore -q "$f" && echo OK $f || echo MISS $f; done` should print OK x7. Project gotchas to remember: no em-dash in persisted docs (irrelevant here, but watch the commit message); conventional commits required (`chore:` or `fix:` is appropriate).

userStories.notes: Files: test/embedded.test.ts (only). Append a new `describe('CAM-68: harness runtime marker ignore rules', ...)` block to the existing file (do not rewrite the existing tests; surgical change rule from CLAUDE.md global section 2). Two kinds of assertions: (1) byte-content checks on the imported `templatesContents` map (already exported from src/vendor/_generated.ts; existing tests show the import shape), looping over the 7 expected substrings and asserting `expect(gitignore).toContain(rule)`; (2) a git-state guard that runs `git ls-files --error-unmatch .claude/.cam-orchestrator-prompt.txt` via `Bun.spawnSync` and asserts the exit code is NON-ZERO (file is NOT tracked). Bun pattern: `const r = Bun.spawnSync(['git', 'ls-files', '--error-unmatch', '.claude/.cam-orchestrator-prompt.txt']); expect(r.exitCode).not.toBe(0);` (per scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md 'Project Stack', prefer Bun.spawn/Bun.$ over node:child_process). If the test must skip outside a git working tree (defensive), guard on `Bun.spawnSync(['git','rev-parse','--git-dir']).exitCode === 0` first, but the cam-cli repo always has one, so a hard assertion is fine. Do NOT add a check for the other six markers' tracked-state: only the orchestrator-prompt file (the noisy one called out in the issue body) needs the re-tracking guard; pinning the other 6 in templatesContents is sufficient and avoids brittle 'is the file present in working tree' checks (sidecar.pid / orch-ready may legitimately be absent on a clean checkout). The 'no em-dash in persisted .md' rule does not apply (this is .ts).
